author: Madison Beale
text:
REALTORS AND BUYERS BEWARE of Curtis Robinson with East Coast Septic. I am a real estate professional who has been selling real estate in St. Augustine for almost nine years. Curtis was recommended to me by a fellow agent for septic inspections. He inspected the septic at a property where I was representing the buyer and determined that the septic pump tank and alarm system needed to be replaced. No problem there. He provided a quote and told us he would not be available until late February or early March, which we were also fine with. I negotiated for the seller to cover the cost based on his estimate.

Over the next two and a half weeks, the seller repeatedly tried to reach Curtis to sign a proposal and get the job officially on the schedule so we could close on time. He did not follow through. Then, approximately three days before closing, Curtis informed the seller that he was no longer interested in taking on the job because he was too busy.

This put my buyer’s binder deposit at risk, jeopardized their livelihood, and completely delayed the transaction. We are still working to find a solution because of this. It also put us in a very dangerous position with contractual deadlines.

As a professional in this community, he should have known better. He should have been transparent, communicative, and honest from the beginning about whether or not he could actually take on this job. Providing an estimate, indicating availability, then avoiding the seller’s calls and backing out at the last minute is unacceptable.

The lack of professionalism here is dangerous in a real estate transaction. I do not recommend using this company.

author: Maria Miranda Parmentier
text: I have used East Coast Septic on a couple of occasions. Curtis always shows up on time and is very knowledgeable in his field.  Local businesses are hard to come by these days, thank you for doing a great job!!!

author: Jennifer Creech
text: Curtis and his team were amazing.  He had to take over a job that another septic installer failed to complete and he gave great advise as to how to  handle the installation. I had a complicted system on the intracoastal waterway and he was extremely competent and professional.  He also has his own heavy machines and septic pumps to complete the job.  I would use him again in the future and am very happy with his work.

author: Peggy Berrier
text: Curtis Robinson did an outstanding job.  We had quotes from three different local septic services.  Geoffrey Batteiger of Septic Services Inc. did the perc test, site plan and obtained our permit.  Geoffrey shared all three companies we had contacted would do a good job.  However, two of the companies had a supervisor who managed several installations crews.  Curtis does his own installations. We have a native Florida lot with many oak trees, palmettos, bushes and vines.  Geoffrey shared Curtis would take more care and not bulldoze down our landscape needlessly.  Our job was scheduled only to find our underground electric and cable lines were right in the middle of our new proposed drain field.  Working with FPL was not a positive experience.  Curtis did clear the area and dig a very long trench for the new electric lines and laid the conduit.  Curtis did this for a very reasonable price.  We then waited weeks for FPL to make the new connection and disconnect the old line.  Once the new lines were laid, Curtis very efficiently removed our old cement tank, installed a new tank and drain field.  For the installation Curtis had to remove many palmettos and clear the area.  Curtis had to chain saw, cut and bulldoze to get the area ready for the drain field. He did a great job removing no more than was absolutely needed.  There were thousands of roots.  Curtis never complained about the delay from FPL which impacted his schedule or our jungle lot.  He was very flexible, dependable, and always pleasant.  It was our pleasure to work with Curtis.  The actual installation of the tank and drain field only took a few days and was professionally completed.  I would highly recommend Curtis and thank him for his patience in working with FPL and our jungle lot.

author: Chad Wood
text: I had a bio-kinetic system installed on the home I recently built. The owner (Curtis) was very professional, courteous, and did an outstanding job. His prices are fair, and he is obviously extremely knowledgeable. My wife and I couldn't be more pleased.
